title: ORS 777.190 Ordinances for policing or regulating of port property
relevance: Core legal source showing a port may police property it owns operates maintains or controls and may appoint peace officers to enforce those ordinances.
notes: This is the clearest current official authority for rejecting a Portland-only or airport-only reading of Port police powers.

title: Public Safety / Airport Police and Fire Services
relevance: Current official police page showing Port Police are real sworn officers and documenting primary jurisdiction at PDX.
notes: Useful for the PDX component and for confirming the ORI is a real police department rather than a generic administrative row.
